title: Comparison of Kähler quotients of torus actions
summary: Let $T$ be a torus with the complexification $T^{\mathbb{C}}$ and $(X, ds^{2})$ a compact Kähler Hamiltonian $T$-manifold with the moment map $Φ$ such that $T^{\mathbb{C}}$ acts on $X$ holomorphically. For each $α$ in the moment body $Φ(X)$, the Kähler quotient $X_α=Φ^{-1}(α)/T$ is a reduced normal complex analytic space admitting a unique Kähler structure $κ_α$ induced from $ds^{2}$.
